### Read Seurat and ArchR object for plotting. 
#### Critical: change the directory to your working dir accordingly!
The DORC matrix was called with FigR. Here we provide called peak-GEX correlation dataframe and MAGIC-smoothed DORC/RNA matrix.
```{r include = TRUE}
RDSdir <- "/media/zeemeeuw/TAI-seq/mmTAI/RNA/" # output RDS file dir
ATACdir <- "/media/zeemeeuw/TAI-seq/mmTAI/ATAC/overlapped_harmony/" # ATAC root dir
seu <- readRDS(paste0(RDSdir, "lm_merged_overlapped_harmony.rds"))
proj <- loadArchRProject(ATACdir)

# load smoothed DORC and RNA matrix
load(paste0(RDSdir, "lm_merged_overlapped_harmony_mat_smoothed.RData"))

# load peak-GEX correlation dataframe
load(paste0(RDSdir, "lm_merged_overlapped_harmony_DORC3.RData"))
gpcorr.use <- gpcorr.use_raw[gpcorr.use_raw$rObs > 0,]
gpcorr.use <- gpcorr.use[gpcorr.use$pvalZ <= 0.05,]
dorcGenes <- sort(unique(gpcorr.use$Gene))
```

### Chromatin potential for primary responses
```{r eval=TRUE, include=TRUE, echo=TRUE, results='hold', collapse=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.height=8, fig.width=8}
trajs <- c("Ln.trajectory", "Spleen.trajectory", "Blood.trajectory", "Liver.trajectory")
plist <- list()
for(trajectory in trajs){
  cells <- proj$cellNames[!is.na(getCellColData(proj, select = trajectory, drop = TRUE))]
  pseudotime <- getCellColData(proj, select = trajectory, drop = TRUE)[!is.na(getCellColData(proj, select = trajectory, drop = TRUE))]
  archdata <- data.frame(cells = proj$cellNames, pseudotime = getCellColData(proj, select = trajectory, drop = TRUE))
  rownames(archdata) <- archdata$cells
  data <- data.frame(seu@reductions$UMAP_LSI_Combined_batch3.3@cell.embeddings) 
  data$barcode <- rownames(data)
  data <- cbind(data, seu@meta.data)
  data$pseudotime <- archdata$pseudotime[rownames(data)]
  data_sub <- data[cells,]
  
  
  idx <- which(rowMeans(dorcMat_sm_norm - rnaMat_sm_norm) > 0)
  norm_list <- filter_matrix(dmat = dorcMat_sm[idx,cells], rmat = rnaMat_sm[idx,cells], scale_max_abs_val = 10, gene_corr_cutoff = 0, scaling = 'minmax', ncore = 12)
  ndmat <- norm_list[["ndmat"]]
  nrmat <- norm_list[["nrmat"]]
  embedding <- seu@reductions$UMAP_LSI_Combined_batch3.3@cell.embeddings[cells,]
  embedding_arr_length_list <- calc_velocity(ndmat, nrmat, embedding, max_per_cell = 10, metric = 'cosine', cutoff = 0.95)
  embedding_arr_length <- embedding_arr_length_list[[1]]
  arr_length <- embedding_arr_length_list[[2]]
  arrow_data <- smooth_arrows(embedding, embedding_arr_length, smooth_w = 30, min_count = 5, coef = 2, draw_all = FALSE)
  
  xrange <- max(data$UMAPCombinedbatch33_1) - min(data$UMAPCombinedbatch33_1)
  yrange <- max(data$UMAPCombinedbatch33_2) - min(data$UMAPCombinedbatch33_2)
  
  p <- ggplot(data, aes(x = UMAPCombinedbatch33_1, y = UMAPCombinedbatch33_2)) +
    geom_scattermore(aes(x = UMAPCombinedbatch33_1, y = UMAPCombinedbatch33_2), color = "grey90", show.legend = FALSE) +
    theme_classic() +
    geom_scattermore(data = data_sub, aes(x = UMAPCombinedbatch33_1, y = UMAPCombinedbatch33_2, color = cell_module), pointsize = 3, show.legend = FALSE) +
    geom_segment(data = arrow_data, aes(x = x_start, y = y_start, xend = x_end, yend = y_end), arrow = arrow(length = unit(3 , 'pt'), type = "closed"), lwd = 0.3, color = 'black') +
    coord_fixed(ratio = xrange/yrange) +
    scale_color_manual(values = mmjoint_colors)
  plist <- c(plist, list(p))
}

wrap_plots(plist, nrow = 2)

```

### Line plots for checkpoints, DORC -> RNA
```{r eval=TRUE, include=TRUE, echo=TRUE, results='hold', collapse=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.height=5, fig.width=12}


# DORC -> RNA
trajectory <- "Spleen.trajectory"
cells <- proj$cellNames[!is.na(getCellColData(proj, select = trajectory, drop = TRUE))]
pseudotime <- getCellColData(proj, select = trajectory, drop = TRUE)[!is.na(getCellColData(proj, select = trajectory, drop = TRUE))]
archdata <- data.frame(cells = proj$cellNames, pseudotime = getCellColData(proj, select = trajectory, drop = TRUE))
rownames(archdata) <- archdata$cells
data <- data.frame(seu@reductions$UMAP_LSI_Combined_batch3.3@cell.embeddings) 
data$barcode <- rownames(data)
data <- cbind(data, seu@meta.data)
archdata <- archdata[rownames(data),]
data$pseudotime <- archdata$pseudotime
data$Trajectory <- data$pseudotime
data_sub <- data[cells,]

idx <- which(rowMeans(dorcMat_sm_norm - rnaMat_sm_norm) > 0)

norm_list <- filter_matrix(dmat = dorcMat_sm_norm[idx,rownames(data_sub)], rmat = rnaMat_sm_norm[idx,rownames(data_sub)], scale_max_abs_val = 10, gene_corr_cutoff = 0, scaling = 'minmax', ncore = 12)
ndmat <- norm_list[["ndmat"]]
nrmat <- norm_list[["nrmat"]]

embedding <- seu@reductions$UMAP_LSI_Combined_batch3.3@cell.embeddings[rownames(data_sub),]

plist <- list()
for (k in c(1, 10, 50)) {
  df_time <- calc_neigh(data_sub, ndmat, nrmat, embedding[rownames(data_sub),], max_per_cell = k, metric = 'cosine', cutoff = 0.95)
  df_time$cellnames <- data_sub$cellnames
  df_time_corrected <- df_time %>% 
    dplyr::mutate(new_time = if_else(old_time > 98 & new_time < 60, new_time + 100, new_time)) %>% 
    dplyr::mutate(diff = new_time - old_time)
  df_time_corrected$y <- df_time_corrected$diff
  df_time_corrected$x <- df_time_corrected$old_time
  
  # spline fitting
  library(splines)
  knots <- 1:50 * 2 -1
  fit <- lm(y ~ ns(x, knots = knots, Boundary.knots = c(0, 100)), data = df_time_corrected)
  predict_y <- function(x_new) {
    predict(fit, newdata = data.frame(x = x_new))
  }
  
  # calc roots
  roots <- list()
  for (i in 0:99) {
    f <- function(x) predict_y(x)
    root <- tryCatch({
      # if(predict_y(i + 1) - predict_y(i) < 1){return(NA)}
      uniroot(f, interval = c(i, i + 1))$root
    },
    error = function(e) NA 
    )
    roots[[i + 1]] <- root
  }
  valid_roots <- unlist(roots[!is.na(roots)])
  spline_deriv <- function(x) {
    h <- 1e-5
    (predict(fit, newdata = data.frame(x = x + h)) - 
        predict(fit, newdata = data.frame(x = x - h))) / (2 * h)
  }
  
  derivatives_at_roots <- sapply(valid_roots, spline_deriv)
  valid_roots <- valid_roots[derivatives_at_roots > 0]
  
  find_extrema <- function(a, b, n = 100) {
    x_grid <- seq(a, b, length.out = n)  
    deriv_values <- sapply(x_grid, spline_deriv)
    extrema <- c()
    for (i in 2:(n - 1)) {
      if (deriv_values[i] * deriv_values[i + 1] < 0) { 
        root <- uniroot(
          spline_deriv,
          interval = c(x_grid[i], x_grid[i + 1]),
          tol = 1e-6
        )$root
        extrema <- c(extrema, root)
      }
    }
    return(extrema)
  }
  
  extrema_x <- find_extrema(0, 100)
  extreme_filter <- sapply(valid_roots, function(x){
    x_start <- tail(extrema_x[which(extrema_x < x)], 1)
    if(length(x_start) == 0) x_start <- 0
    x_end <- head(extrema_x[which(extrema_x > x)], 1)
    if(length(x_end) == 0) x_end <- 100
    predict_y(x_end) - predict_y(x_start) > 2
  })
  valid_roots <- valid_roots[extreme_filter]
  print(valid_roots)
  
  df_time_corrected$tech = "DORC"
  df_time_corrected$diff_pred <- predict_y(df_time_corrected$old_time)
  
  # saveRDS(df_time_corrected, paste0(RDSdir, "chromatin_checkpoint_", 'Spleen.trajectory', "_k_", k, ".rds"))

  
  p <- ggplot(df_time_corrected, aes(x = old_time, color = tech)) +
    geom_line(aes(y = diff_pred), size = 1) +
    theme_bw() +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = 2) +
    theme(panel.grid = element_blank(),
          axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8, color = "black"),
          axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8, color = "black"),
          axis.title.x = element_text(size = 13),
          axis.title.y = element_text(size = 13)) +
    scale_color_manual(values = color_tech) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = valid_roots, linetype = 2, color = "#4d004b") +
    xlim(0, 100) +
    ylim(-10, 13) +
    coord_fixed(100 / 23) +
    # coord_fixed(100 / (max(df_time_corrected$diff_pred) - min(df_time_corrected$diff_pred))) +
    ggtitle(paste0("B-spline, k = ", k))
  plist <- c(plist, list(p))
}
wrap_plots(plist, nrow = 1)
```

### Chromatin potential for DORC-DORC

```{r eval=TRUE, include=TRUE, echo=TRUE, results='hold', collapse=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.height=5, fig.width=12}
  df_time_corrected <- df_time %>%

  # spline fitting
  library(splines)

  predict_y <- function(x_new) {

  }
  
  # calc roots
  roots <- list()
  for (i in 0:99) {
    f <- function(x) predict_y(x)
    root <- tryCatch({
      # if(predict_y(i + 1) - predict_y(i) < 1){return(NA)}

  spline_deriv <- function(x) {
    h <- 1e-5
    (predict(fit, newdata = data.frame(x = x + h)) - 
        predict(fit, newdata = data.frame(x = x - h))) / (2 * h)
  }
  
  derivatives_at_roots <- sapply(valid_roots, spline_deriv)
  valid_roots <- valid_roots[derivatives_at_roots > 0]
  
  find_extrema <- function(a, b, n = 100) {
    x_grid <- seq(a, b, length.out = n)  
    deriv_values <- sapply(x_grid, spline_deriv)
    extrema <- c()
    for (i in 2:(n - 1)) {
      if (deriv_values[i] * deriv_values[i + 1] < 0) { 
        root <- uniroot(
          spline_deriv,
          interval = c(x_grid[i], x_grid[i + 1]),
          tol = 1e-6
        )$root
        extrema <- c(extrema, root)
      }
    }
    return(extrema)
  }
  
  extrema_x <- find_extrema(0, 100)
  extreme_filter <- sapply(valid_roots, function(x){
    x_start <- tail(extrema_x[which(extrema_x < x)], 1)
    if(length(x_start) == 0) x_start <- 0
    x_end <- head(extrema_x[which(extrema_x > x)], 1)
    if(length(x_end) == 0) x_end <- 100
    predict_y(x_end) - predict_y(x_start) > 2
  })
  if(k != 1) valid_roots <- valid_roots[extreme_filter]
  print(valid_roots)
  
  df_time_corrected$tech = "DORC"
  df_time_corrected$diff_pred <- predict_y(df_time_corrected$old_time)
  
  
  p <- ggplot(df_time_corrected, aes(x = old_time, color = tech)) +
    geom_line(aes(y = diff_pred), size = 1) +
    theme_bw() +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = 2) +
    theme(panel.grid = element_blank(),
          axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8, color = "black"),
          axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8, color = "black"),
          axis.title.x = element_text(size = 13),
          axis.title.y = element_text(size = 13)) +
    scale_color_manual(values = color_tech) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = valid_roots, linetype = 2, color = "#4d004b") +
    xlim(0, 100) +
    ylim(-10, 13) +
    coord_fixed(100 / 23) +
    # coord_fixed(100 / (max(df_time_corrected$diff_pred) - min(df_time_corrected$diff_pred))) +
    ggtitle(paste0("B-spline, k = ", k))
  plist <- c(plist, list(p))
}
wrap_plots(plist, nrow = 1)
```

### Line plots for checkpoints, RNA -> RNA
```{r eval=TRUE, include=TRUE, echo=TRUE, results='hold', collapse=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.height=5, fig.width=12}

# RNA -> RNA

trajectory <- "Spleen.trajectory"
cells <- proj$cellNames[!is.na(getCellColData(proj, select = trajectory, drop = TRUE))]
pseudotime <- getCellColData(proj, select = trajectory, drop = TRUE)[!is.na(getCellColData(proj, select = trajectory, drop = TRUE))]
archdata <- data.frame(cells = proj$cellNames, pseudotime = getCellColData(proj, select = trajectory, drop = TRUE))
rownames(archdata) <- archdata$cells
data <- data.frame(seu@reductions$UMAP_LSI_Combined_batch3.3@cell.embeddings) 
data$barcode <- rownames(data)
data <- cbind(data, seu@meta.data)
archdata <- archdata[rownames(data),]
data$pseudotime <- archdata$pseudotime
data$Trajectory <- data$pseudotime
data_sub <- data[cells,]

idx <- which(rowMeans(dorcMat_sm_norm - rnaMat_sm_norm) > 0)


norm_list <- filter_matrix(dmat = dorcMat_sm_norm[idx,rownames(data_sub)], rmat = rnaMat_sm_norm[idx,rownames(data_sub)], scale_max_abs_val = 10, gene_corr_cutoff = 0, scaling = 'minmax', ncore = 12)
ndmat <- norm_list[["nrmat"]]
nrmat <- norm_list[["nrmat"]]

embedding <- seu@reductions$UMAP_LSI_Combined_batch3.3@cell.embeddings[rownames(data_sub),]

plist <- list()
for (k in c(1, 10, 50)) {
  df_time <- calc_neigh(data_sub, ndmat, nrmat, embedding[rownames(data_sub),], max_per_cell = k, metric = 'cosine', cutoff = 0.95)
  df_time_corrected <- df_time %>% 
    dplyr::mutate(new_time = if_else(old_time > 98 & new_time < 60, new_time + 100, new_time)) %>% 
    dplyr::mutate(diff = new_time - old_time)
  df_time_corrected$y <- df_time_corrected$diff
  df_time_corrected$x <- df_time_corrected$old_time
  
  # spline fitting
  library(splines)
  knots <- 1:50 * 2 -1
  fit <- lm(y ~ ns(x, knots = knots, Boundary.knots = c(0, 100)), data = df_time_corrected)
  predict_y <- function(x_new) {
    predict(fit, newdata = data.frame(x = x_new))
  }
  
  # calc roots
  roots <- list()
  for (i in 0:99) {
    f <- function(x) predict_y(x)
    root <- tryCatch({
      # if(predict_y(i + 1) - predict_y(i) < 1){return(NA)}
      uniroot(f, interval = c(i, i + 1))$root
    },
    error = function(e) NA 
    )
    roots[[i + 1]] <- root
  }
  valid_roots <- unlist(roots[!is.na(roots)])
  spline_deriv <- function(x) {
    h <- 1e-5
    (predict(fit, newdata = data.frame(x = x + h)) - 
        predict(fit, newdata = data.frame(x = x - h))) / (2 * h)
  }
  
  derivatives_at_roots <- sapply(valid_roots, spline_deriv)
  valid_roots <- valid_roots[derivatives_at_roots > 0]
  
  find_extrema <- function(a, b, n = 100) {
    x_grid <- seq(a, b, length.out = n)  
    deriv_values <- sapply(x_grid, spline_deriv)
    extrema <- c()
    for (i in 2:(n - 1)) {
      if (deriv_values[i] * deriv_values[i + 1] < 0) { 
        root <- uniroot(
          spline_deriv,
          interval = c(x_grid[i], x_grid[i + 1]),
          tol = 1e-6
        )$root
        extrema <- c(extrema, root)
      }
    }
    return(extrema)
  }
  
  extrema_x <- find_extrema(0, 100)
  extreme_filter <- sapply(valid_roots, function(x){
    x_start <- tail(extrema_x[which(extrema_x < x)], 1)
    if(length(x_start) == 0) x_start <- 0
    x_end <- head(extrema_x[which(extrema_x > x)], 1)
    if(length(x_end) == 0) x_end <- 100
    predict_y(x_end) - predict_y(x_start) > 2
  })
  if(k != 1) valid_roots <- valid_roots[extreme_filter]
  
  print(valid_roots)
  
  df_time_corrected$tech = "DORC"
  df_time_corrected$diff_pred <- predict_y(df_time_corrected$old_time)
  
  
  p <- ggplot(df_time_corrected, aes(x = old_time, color = tech)) +
    geom_line(aes(y = diff_pred), size = 1) +
    theme_bw() +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = 2) +
    theme(panel.grid = element_blank(),
          axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8, color = "black"),
          axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8, color = "black"),
          axis.title.x = element_text(size = 13),
          axis.title.y = element_text(size = 13)) +
    scale_color_manual(values = color_tech) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = valid_roots, linetype = 2, color = "#4d004b") +
    xlim(0, 100) +
    ylim(-10, 13) +
    coord_fixed(100 / 23) +
    # coord_fixed(100 / (max(df_time_corrected$diff_pred) - min(df_time_corrected$diff_pred))) +
    ggtitle(paste0("B-spline, k = ", k))
  plist <- c(plist, list(p))
  
}
wrap_plots(plist, nrow = 1)
```
